subject: Billing ownership & signer rotation — portal opt-in exception
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@horizonhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@horizonhealth.com, billing@horizonhealth.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — invoicing, signer rotation, and VAT

Hi Soojin,

We're kicking off onboarding for Redwood for our AP team. A couple of quick items so we can schedule the finance integration:

- Who at Redwood will be listed as the invoice "issuer" for our ledger? We need a named contact (and job title) for our ERP mapping.
- We have rotating signatories on our side — we'll need to know whether you require a fixed signer name on invoices or if a generic company sign-off (e.g., "Redwood Inference, Finance Team") is acceptable.
- Preferred delivery: our AP prefers portal push (SFTP/API) for automation but can accept PDF emailed to billing@horizonhealth.com for the first 60 days while we finish the vendor tokenization. Any constraints on that?
- VAT/tax proof: attaching our Horizon VAT cert for completeness.

Attaching: PO-987654.pdf

Appreciate a quick run-down so we can finalize the PO mapping.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Sr. Manager, Procurement
Horizon Health

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — invoicing, signer rotation, and VAT

Hi Samir — great to meet you over email. Thanks for the PO and the VAT cert. Looping in Kim (ops) and Naomi (finance) to confirm internal requirements. Quick answers below, plus a couple of asks so we match Horizon's ERP mapping exactly.

1) Invoice issuer & contact: Redwood typically uses a named billing contact + "Redwood Inference" as the legal issuer line. For mapping, please use:
   - Invoice Issuer: Redwood Inference
   - Billing contact: Soojin Lee, Head of Finance Ops (soojin.lee@redwood.com)

2) Signer rotation: We do not require a single fixed named signer on the PDF invoice. A company-level sign-off is acceptable (we include an authorized-by block with signatory title), but if Horizon's ERP requires a specific individual for your PO match rules, let us know and we can adjust.

3) Delivery mechanism: Portal/API (preferred) is supported — we can push invoices via secure webhook (or SFTP) into your system. For short-term onboarding, we can also email PDF copies to billing@horizonhealth.com. Two notes:
   - If you choose email fallback, confirm whether you need the PDF signed or just a signed-by title in the body.
   - For portal push we will require an initial token exchange; if you need a temporary email-only window, we can keep that active for 60 days as you suggested.

4) VAT evidence: we can include your VAT id on the invoice and attach a copy of your supplied certificate. We also keep VAT evidence in our records for audit.

Attachments: none in this message.

Next step: Kim, can you confirm whether Redwood needs to mark invoices with an internal ledger id (e.g., an allocation tag) for Horizon, or will Horizon map by PO + billing contact?

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:54:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — invoicing, signer rotation, and VAT

Thanks, Soojin / Samir. Quick operational answers from billing ops:

- Ledger mapping: We can emit an "external_ledger_code" custom field on the invoice metadata (if Horizon provides the code). Otherwise we'll put PO + BillingContact in the mapping table and Horizon ERP can match on PO number.
- Signatures: For emailed PDFs we include an "Authorized by: Finance Team" footer. If Horizon requires a specific signer name to pass PO validation, please tell us the field name ("ApproverName", "Signer", etc.) and we will populate that value from our rotation list for the first invoice.
- Portal onboarding: We support SFTP, API webhook, and secured email push. For API/webhook you'll need to generate a short-lived inbound token, or we can create an outbound SFTP user. We can also provide a sample payload mapping (JSON) for your engineering team.

Attachments: sample-invoice-payload.json (stub)

Samir — can you confirm which route you want us to use for the first two invoices while you finish tokenization? Also confirm whether the AP system requires a named signer field for PO matching.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@horizonhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@horizonhealth.com, billing@horizonhealth.com
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — invoicing, signer rotation, and VAT

Hi Kimberly / Soojin — thanks for the clarity. We discussed internally and decided:

- Short-term (first 60 days): PDF emailed to billing@horizonhealth.com (our AP team will manually upload). Please attach the PO and include the VAT id on invoice header.
- After tokenization window: we'll move to API webhook (preferred) — I'll share the token and endpoint with you when ready.
- Signer: Our ERP requires a signer field named "ApproverName" for PO validation. For the first invoice please populate ApproverName with "Redwood Finance Team" (your company-level sign-off). We will update to a named approver later if needed.
- Ledger code: we'll provide an "HH-IT-03" external ledger code in the vendor profile — please populate external_ledger_code when you emit invoices.

I've attached Horizon-VAT-Cert.pdf and re-sent PO-987654.pdf for reference.

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Once tokenization is complete I'll ping Naomi to confirm API tests.

Regards,
Samir Patel
Sr. Manager, Procurement
Horizon Health
